pages.title: Shapeless recipe
pages.label: Combine → one result
pages.text: Healing Slime + nether star + totem of undying. The exact totem becomes the initial reserve. Empty the Healing Slime’s bag before crafting; the guardian has no bag.

Starts waiting. Follow lets it fly after its owner. It can defend itself or its nearby owner even while waiting. Retaliatory beams use Attack, Work Speed, Reach, and stamina; they do not seek distant enemies.

Health is four times the common value: initially 64, +16 per Health point. A reserve slot holds up to 64 matching totems. One guardian can spend one to save its owner from lethal damage within 16 blocks; held totems act first.
